edge.oodTitle: This doesn't look like a recognised crop photo
edge.oodDescription: Our safety gate rejected this image because it contains non-foliar elements, heavy background clutter, or graphics.
edge.oodTip1: Take a well-lit photo of a single leaf.
edge.oodTip2: Avoid photos with product labels, text, or human fingers.
edge.oodTip3: Hold your camera steady about 10-15 cm away.
edge.uncertainDescription: The visual symptoms are ambiguous. Retake in better daylight or seek verification from an agronomist.
edge.healthyDescription: No fungal, bacterial, or pest lesions detected. Continue standard preventative maintenance!

tips.title: How to get 99%+ accurate scans
tips.tip1Desc: Photograph in natural morning or afternoon sunlight, avoiding heavy shadows.
tips.tip2Desc: Focus on 1-2 symptomatic leaves rather than the entire garden bed.
tips.tip3Desc: Keep camera 10–20 cm away and tap the leaf on your screen to focus.
tips.tip4Desc: Ensure fingers, product packaging, and artificial labels are kept out.
